<!-- One unit of work: one theme, one fix, one feature. CONTRIBUTING.md has the checks. -->

What it changes, and why:

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --release` pass
- [ ] A visible change: only the reference pictures it was meant to change are made again (`RETRO_BLESS=1`)
- [ ] No theme key, setting or plugin field is renamed or removed (EXTENDING.md, "What stays stable")
